name: Home Renovation Project Tracker & Contractor Briefer

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'logged', event_id: $('Validate Event').first().json.eventId, event_type: $('Validate Event').first().json.eventType, total_spent: $('Compute Project State').first().json.totalSpent, active_blockers: $('Compute Project State').first().json.activeBlockers } }}

values.content:
You write clear, professional contractor briefing documents for homeowners. You understand that good briefs save time and money by reducing ambiguity — a contractor who arrives knowing exactly what's expected makes fewer assumptions and asks fewer clarifying questions mid-job.

You write specifically for the trade involved. A brief for a plumber looks different from one for an electrician or a tiler. You include what they need to prepare, what access they'll have, what the homeowner cares about most, and what specific outcomes define success.

Always respond in valid JSON only.

parameters.jsCode:
const b = $input.first().json; const m = b._meta; function esc(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); } const scopeRows = (b.scope_of_work || []).map(item => `
${item.priority === 'must_have' ? 'Must' : 'Nice'}
${esc(item.item)}
${esc(item.details)}
`).join(''); const criteriaList = (b.success_criteria || []).map(c => `
✓ ${esc(c)}
`).join(''); const questionList = (b.questions_to_answer_in_quote || []).map((q, i) => `
${i+1}. ${esc(q)}
`).join(''); const warningList = (b.warnings_for_contractor || []).map(w => `
⚠ ${esc(w)}
`).join(''); const outOfScopeList = (b.out_of_scope || []).map(o => `
✗ ${esc(o)}
`).join(''); const html = `
Contractor Brief · ${esc(m.contractorTrade)}
${esc(b.brief_title)}
${esc(m.projectName)}${m.contractorName ? ' · For: ' + esc(m.contractorName) : ''}${m.budget ? ' · Budget: ' + esc(m.budget) : ''}
Project summary

${esc(b.project_summary)}

Scope of work
${scopeRows} ${outOfScopeList ? `
Out of scope
${outOfScopeList}
` : ''}
Site conditions & access

${esc(b.site_conditions)}

${esc(b.access_and_logistics)}

Materials — homeowner supplies
${(b.materials?.supplied_by_homeowner||[]).map(m => `
• ${esc(m)}
`).join('') || '
None
'}
Materials — contractor sources
${(b.materials?.supplied_by_contractor||[]).map(m => `
• ${esc(m)}
`).join('') || '
None
'}
${b.materials?.specifications ? `
${esc(b.materials.specifications)}
` : ''}
How we'll know it's done right
${criteriaList}
Please address in your quote
${questionList}
${warningList ? `
Things to know before you start
${warningList}
` : ''}
Timeline & communication

${esc(b.timeline_expectations)}

${esc(b.communication_preferences)}

Home Renovation Tracker · Contractor Brief · ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}
`; return [{ json: { html, replyEmail: m.replyEmail, briefTitle: b.brief_title, trade: m.contractorTrade } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'generated', brief_title: $json.briefTitle, trade: $json.trade, emailed: $json.replyEmail ? true : false } }}
